thread:
maya: Quick pass on the metrics dashboard charts — putting this here before the design sync. Posting screenshots in the doc thread.
sam: Nice. First thought: tooltips feel crowded when we show smoothed line + raw points. Maybe a toggle for 'show raw points'? :thinking:
liam: Agree. Also legend ordering should match drawing order. Right now legend sorts alphabetically which confuses readers when colors overlap.
maya: Good call. We should allow explicit order in the chart config. For now, can we change to 'render order' instead of alphabetical?
jordan: Accessibility nit: the color for the anomaly series doesn't meet contrast for colorblind palettes. Could we add pattern fills or distinct shapes for points? Screen readers also need descriptive aria-labels like "requests per minute (smoothed)".
sam: Pattern fills might be heavy. Suggest: dashed line for smoothed, solid for raw, and a diamond marker for anomalies. Also add the units suffix to y-axis: 'Responses / min' instead of just 'Count'.
liam: On smoothing — users keep asking why peaks disappear. We should surface the smoothing window size in the tooltip (e.g., "7-pt moving avg") and provide a 'show unsmoothed peak' quick toggle on hover.
maya: Love that. Copy tweak for the legend: change 'Smoothed avg' to '7-pt smooth (moving avg)' — a bit longer but clearer. Keep axis label concise with units in parentheses.
aria-bot: Note: design-contrast-checker failed for series 'anomaly' at WCAG AA. See ticket #4021
jordan: For outlier handling: proposal — cap the axis by default at the 99.5th percentile and show a clipped indicator (∧) near the top with tooltip 'value clipped; click to expand scale'. Keeps trends readable but preserves access to extremes.
sam: If we clip by percentile, we must be explicit in the legend tooltip and include a persisted user toggle in the top-right 'include extreme values'. Also expose the clip threshold in the chart settings.
maya: :thumbsup: I'll mock a compact tooltip layout: line 1 = series name + units, line 2 = value + timestamp, line 3 = modifiers (smoothed window / clipped). Will post mocks in the doc link shortly.
liam: Small mobile touch target nit: legend items should have 12px min tap spacing, they're tiny on small screens now.
maya: Thanks — I'll include mobile spacing and update the ordering behavior. Sync agenda: finalize legend order, smoothing copy, clipping indicator, ARIA labels. Can people review the mock by EOD?
sam: I'll check contrast + shape proposals and post alternatives by 3pm.
jordan: I'll draft aria strings and a11y test cases (screen reader flow, keyboard nav) and drop them in the doc
